data.name: Ghurrah
data.gender_notes: Ghurrah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'ghara', meaning 'to shine' or 'to glow'. In Islamic tradition, Ghurrah represents the radiant light or shining face of an angel or a beloved one. The name Ghurrah carries the meaning “Radiant light, shining face” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Ghurrah usually hope their child will grow to embody radiant light, shining face and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name inspired by the divine light of Allah, signifying a connection to the spiritual realm.
data.etymology: Ghurrah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Radiant light, shining face.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ghurrah total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

in_arabic.name: غُرَّة
in_arabic.meaning: علامت، خصوصیت، عظمت و جلال کی علامت
in_arabic.long_meaning: غُرَّة اسم مشتق از غُرّة، به معنی علامت، خصوصیت، یا عظمت و جلال کی علامت. یہ نام عظمت، شان و شوکت، اور خوبی کی خصوصیت کو ظاہر کرتا ہے. غُرَّة کی اصطلاح قرآن مجید میں بھی استعمال ہوئی ہے، جیسے کہ 'وَلَئِنْ أَخَذْنَاْ أَحَدًا مِّنْهُم بِالْغُرَّةِ' (النساء: ೧೪೩)۔ اس نام کا انتخاب بچے کی زندگی میں عظمت، خوبی، اور اچھائی کی امید پر مبنی ہوتا ہے.

in_urdu.name: غُرَّہ
in_urdu.meaning: علامت، خصوصیت، شان و شوکت کی نشانی
in_urdu.long_meaning: غُرَّہ ایک مشہور عربی نام ہے جس کا مطلب ہے علامت، خصوصیت، یا شان و شوکت کی نشانی۔ یہ نام عظمت، خوبی، اور اچھائی کی خصوصیت کو ظاہر کرتا ہے۔ اس کا مطلب اسلامی تقویم اور ثقافت میں بھی جڑا ہوا ہے، جہاں یہ نام شان و عظمت کے ساتھ منسلک ہوتا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: घुर्राह
in_hindi.long_meaning: घुर्राह एक सुंदर और अर्थपूर्ण नाम है जो चिह्न, विशेषता, या महिमा का प्रतीक है। यह नाम महानता, अच्छाई और विशिष्टता की विशेषता को दर्शाता है। इस नाम का चयन बच्चे के जीवन में महानता, अच्छाई और सफलता की आशा पर आधारित होता है।

in_pashto.name: غرَّة
in_pashto.long_meaning: غرَّة د عربي اصل يو نوم دی چې د نښه، ځانګړنه، يا عظمت نښه معنی لري. دا نوم د عظمت، نیکۍ، او ځانګړنې خصوصیت څرګندوي. دا نوم د افغان او پښتون کلتور کې هم کارول شواهد لري.

in_english.name: Ghurrah
in_english.meaning: Symbol, characteristic, sign of greatness or nobility
in_english.long_meaning: Ghurrah is a meaningful name derived from Arabic roots, signifying a symbol, characteristic, or sign of greatness and nobility. It reflects attributes of excellence, goodness, and distinctiveness. The term 'Ghurrah' appears in the Quran (An-Nisa: 143), emphasizing its spiritual and cultural significance in Islamic tradition. This name is chosen with hopes of grandeur, goodness, and success in a child's life.

data.cultural_impact: The name Ghurrah holds a deep cultural significance as it is an Arabic name often used amongst Muslims. It reflects the rich heritage and culture of the Arab and Islamic world. Ghurrah is also the name of a famous Arabian mount in Islamic tradition, which symbolizes quickness, agility, and speed.
data.spiritual_significance: Spiritually, the name Ghurrah holds symbolism and significance for its radiant and luminous meaning. In Islamic traditions, angels are described as having shining faces and retinas, and the name Ghurrah can be thought of as a reflection of this divine quality. It is also believed that the name can bring brightness and light into one's life, just as a shining face can bring joy and happiness. Overall, Ghurrah represents a connection to the divine and the spiritual world, embodying the qualities of light, purity, and enlightenment.
